answer: Thirty seats sit on the knoll each epoch: entry costs a 150-POA bond plus three tasks in one shared 30-minute window. One operator can run at most two seats live, so ten fakes need five operators. Each extra identity funded from the same root pays 50 POA more than the last — 150, 200, 250 — so ten linked fakes lock 3,750 POA, and a missed window burns 50 POA per seat. A clone passes the tasks yet fails the audit: the chain traces funding roots and live-window overlap, so ten identities sharing one thread of money or one pair of hands count as one, and the plume of their proofs counts once.
